meta.name: model-usage
meta.description: Use CodexBar CLI local cost usage to summarize per-model usage for Codex or Claude, including the current (most recent) model or a full model breakdown. Trigger when asked for model-level usage/cost data from codexbar, or when you need a scriptable per-model summary from codexbar cost JSON.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按模型汇总 CodexBar 的用量与费用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 CodexBar 并需要按模型查看费用明细
copy.tagline_en: Summarize CodexBar usage and cost per model
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use CodexBar and need per-model cost breakdown

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以读取 CodexBar 的本地费用日志，按模型汇总 Codex 或 Claude 的使用成本，并显示当前（最新）模型或全部模型的费用。
howto.when: 当你询问 Codex 或 Claude 的模型级别使用费用，或要求从 CodexBar 获取按模型汇总的费用数据时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下 Codex 当前模型的费用。
say.note: Claude 会运行脚本获取最新模型费用。

say.text: 列出 Claude 所有模型的费用。
say.note: Claude 会汇总全部模型的费用。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read CodexBar's local cost logs, summarize per-model usage cost for Codex or Claude, and show the current (most recent) model or a full model breakdown.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked for model-level usage/cost data from CodexBar, or when a per-model summary from CodexBar cost JSON is needed.

say_en.text: Show me the current model cost for Codex.
say_en.note: Claude runs the script to get the latest model cost.

say_en.text: List all model costs for Claude.
say_en.note: Claude summarizes costs for all models.
